listeningContent.title: The Little Bird
listeningContent.transcript: One day, a little bird was sitting on a tree. The bird was very tired. It was a hot day. The bird wanted to drink water. It flew down to a small pond. The water was cool and clean. The bird drank some water. Then it felt much better. The bird flew back to the tree and sang a beautiful song.
listeningContent.backgroundInfo: This is a simple story about a bird finding relief on a hot day.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What animal is in the story?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The story is about a little bird.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Where was the bird sitting at first?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'One day, a little bird was sitting on a tree.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why was the bird tired?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text mentions 'It was a hot day' and the bird was tired, suggesting the heat made it tired.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did the bird do after drinking water?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'The bird flew back to the tree and sang a beautiful song.'

listeningContent.title: The Two Friends
listeningContent.transcript: Anu and Ravi are two friends. They go to the same school. Every day they play together at lunch time. They like to play games like hopscotch and jumping. One day, Anu fell and hurt her knee. She was sad. But Ravi helped her stand up. He gave her a tissue to clean her knee. Ravi stayed with Anu. Anu was happy because she had a good friend. The two friends went to the teacher and got a bandage.
listeningContent.backgroundInfo: A story about friendship and helping friends.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What are the names of the friends?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'Anu and Ravi are two friends.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: When do they play together?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'Every day they play together at lunch time.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: What happened to Anu?
options: She fell and hurt her knee
comprehensionQuestions.correctAnswer: She fell and hurt her knee
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'One day, Anu fell and hurt her knee.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: How did Ravi help Anu?
options: He helped her stand up and stayed with her
comprehensionQuestions.correctAnswer: He helped her stand up and stayed with her
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text describes how Ravi helped her stand, gave her a tissue, and stayed with her.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What does this story teach us?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The story shows Ravi helping Anu when she was hurt, demonstrating friendship.

listeningContent.title: The Magic Garden
listeningContent.transcript: One morning, Karan found a small door in his garden. He opened the door and stepped inside. It was a magic garden! Everything was beautiful. There were flowers of every color. The flowers were very big and colorful. There were also many butterflies. The butterflies had blue, yellow, and orange wings. Karan walked around and smelled the flowers. They smelled very sweet. He saw a butterfly with purple wings. It was so pretty. Karan picked one flower and put it in his pocket. When he left the garden, he looked at the flower again. It was still beautiful. Karan smiled and kept the flower as a special memory.
listeningContent.backgroundInfo: A magical and imaginative story for encouraging imagination.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Where did Karan find a door?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'One morning, Karan found a small door in his garden.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did the garden have?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text mentions beautiful flowers and butterflies in the magic garden.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What colors did the butterflies have?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'The butterflies had blue, yellow, and orange wings.'

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why did Karan keep the flower?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: The text says 'Karan kept the flower as a special memory,' meaning he wanted to remember the magic garden.
